sections.heading: 1. Hypsiphrone Descends
sections.body:
The book [concerning those things] seen [by] Hypsiphrone, being [revealed] in the place of [her] virginity.

**1.** [And she heeds] her brothers and sisters [...] Phainops and [...], and they speak [with each other] with a [mystery].

**2.** Now I [was of the first] rank [...] me. I abandoned [the place] of my [virginity] and I went out into the [world].

**3.** [Then I] was informed [about] these things by those who dwell in the [place] of my [virginity].

**4.** And I went down [to the world], and they said to [me, “Once more] Hypsiphrone [has abandoned] the [place of her] virginity.”

**5.** Then he [who] heard, Phainops, [who breathes] into [her fountain of] blood, spread himself [out] for her.

**6.** [And] he said, “[I am Phai]n[ops ...]

**7.** veer away [...] desire of [... those] remnants, or that I may see a [person, of blood-likeness or ...] of a [... fire] and a [... in] his hands.

**8.** Then [I said to] him, “Ph[ainops] has not [come] on me; he [has not] veered away.

**9.** [...] [I] saw a person [...] him

**10.** [...] For [...] what he said [...] Phainops this [...].

**11.** I saw him and [he said] to me, Hypsiphrone, “[why do you avoid] me?

**12.** [Follow me] and I will instruct [you about these things].”

**13.** So I followed [him], for [I] was in [great] fear.

**14.** And he told [me] about a fountain of [blood] that is [revealed by] burning [...] he said [...].
